nodes.title: About Size
widgets_values:
Width & height settings must be divisible by 32 + 1. 
Frame count must be divisible by 8 + 1. 


Running with invalid parameters **will not cause errors**. Instead, the flow will silently choose the closest valid parameters. 

By default, we are using 720p resolution. You can try 1920*1088 if you have a powerful GPU.

nodes.title: Text to Video
widgets_values:
A man stands center stage, playing a Gibson SG electric guitar under flashing rock-concert lights. The crowd roars as the camera pans across cheering fans. The man strikes the first chord — the sound of each guitar string rings out clearly, glowing with electricity in the air. As he launches into a wicked solo, a male singer joins in, his voice powerful and gritty, echoing through the venue.

Background music: Energetic electric guitar solo with pulse-pounding drums and bass.

Lyrics (sung by male voice):
“Ride the lightning, feel the fire,
Six strings burning — take me higher!
Sparks in the air, I’m losing control,
This cat’s got claws and a rock ’n’ roll soul!”

The guitar solo peaks as the lights strobe in rhythm. The crowd throws their hands up, cheering wildly. The shot ends on the guitar neck glowing red-hot as the music fades out.

nodes.title: Frame Rate Note
widgets_values: Please make sure the frame rate value is the same in both boxes

nodes.title: LoRA
widgets_values:
# Using LoRAs
**Ctrl + B to enable**

For the camera LoRA we recommend setting strength = 1

You can use LTX [Ready to use camera LoRAs](https://huggingface.co/collections/Lightricks/ltx-2)




Use a second LoRa only when the details are important in the LoRa. 

## Training
We have made available a full trainer to help you to train your own LoRA. You can [find it here](https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-2).
